articles.title: America's Synthetic Drug Crisis | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 美国合成毒品危机|英国广播公司新闻
articles.summary:
Extraordinary access reveals how powerful synthetic drugs are reshaping America's drug crisis. 

From a jail in Chicago to the streets of Columbus, a new generation of home made drugs are deadlier than ever.

If you are suffering distress or despair and need support, you could speak to a health professional, or an organisation that offers support. Details of help available in many countries can be found at Befrienders Worldwide.

A list of UK organisations that can help is available via BBC Action Line.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: Can smart glasses lose their ‘creepy’ reputation? | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 智能眼镜会失去“令人毛骨悚然”的声誉吗？ | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
For people who are blind or visually impaired, and for workers in trades such as construction, smart glasses can offer hands-free help by describing surroundings and identifying objects.
 
But the glasses have faced serious criticism for being used by some to secretly film.
 
Tech Now's Zoe Kleinman tests out the latest smart glasses and asks if new designs can help to shake off their "creepy" reputation.   

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Technology #BBCNews

For people who are blind or visually impaired, and for workers in trades such as construction, smart glasses can offer hands-free help by describing surroundings and identifying objects.

But the glasses have faced serious criticism for being used by some to secretly film.

Tech Now's Zoe Kleinman tests out the latest smart glasses and asks if new designs can help to shake off their "creepy" reputation.

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news
articles.readingTextZh:
对于盲人或视障人士，以及建筑等行业的工人，智能眼镜可以通过描述周围环境和识别物体来提供免提帮助。

但眼镜因被一些人用来秘密拍摄而受到严厉批评。

Tech Now的Zoe Kleinman测试了最新的智能眼镜，并询问新设计是否可以帮助摆脱他们“令人毛骨悚然”的声誉。
